corrections: Corrected TLS 1.3 key-exchange wording: full handshakes use ephemeral (EC)DHE, while PSK modes may be used alone or combined with (EC)DHE.
Clarified TLS round-trip comparisons and that the initial ClientHello and ServerHello are not encrypted.
Qualified DNS CNAME coexistence rules at the owner name, including standards-defined DNSSEC exceptions.
Replaced absolute cross-subnet and routing-convergence claims with configuration- and protocol-aware boundaries.
Reframed legacy cone/symmetric NAT labels as separate mapping and filtering behaviors, updated TURN to RFC 8656, and removed fixed traversal-success guarantees.
